def trajectory(path,practice=False,speed=8.,comp=1.):
 b=np.array(path);xy=gaussian_filter1d(b[:,:2],2,axis=0);w=gaussian_filter1d(b[:,2],2)
 # Keep the tip in contact through the complete conventional stroke.
 depth=np.maximum(.62,(w/2*MM-MODEL[5])/MODEL[4])
 t=np.gradient(xy,axis=0);t/=np.maximum(1e-9,np.linalg.norm(t,axis=1))[:,None]
 lag=(MODEL[0]*depth+MODEL[1])*comp/MM
 pos=xy+t*lag[:,None]
 if practice:
  world=np.c_[-.118-(pos[:,1]-90)*MM/1000,-.14-(pos[:,0]-590)*MM/1000,.0202-depth/1000]
 else:world=np.c_[-.1+(512-pos[:,1]-.5)*MM/1000,(512-pos[:,0]-.5)*MM/1000,.0202-depth/1000]
 # Parametrize by tip travel, including changing pressure; constant low writing speed.
 s=np.r_[0,np.cumsum(np.linalg.norm(np.diff(world,axis=0),axis=1))*1000];keep=np.r_[True,np.diff(s)>1e-6];s=s[keep];world=world[keep]
 ss=np.linspace(0,s[-1],max(4,int(np.ceil(s[-1]/speed/.05))+1));raw=PchipInterpolator(s,world,axis=0)(ss)
 # Feedforward compensation for measured arm following lag.
 lead=.085/.05
 rows=raw+lead*np.gradient(raw,axis=0)
 return rows,raw,b

 p.move([p.p[0],p.p[1],.06],speed=.04)
